'''Tony Harper''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2001 Lexington tournament]] on 15 December 2001 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|MWHYL Beatdown/Space Drain]], according to Shannon Huecker's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3192">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-18-lexington-ky-chase-the-cans-12-15d3192/ lexington-ky-chase-the-cans-12-15], DeckTech (Shannon "Godsmacker" Huecker, 18 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-18-lexington-ky-chase-the-cans-12-15d3192/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
